findings.action: Count this as coverage of explicit-candidate handling only. Retain original failures and do not infer automatic discovery improved.

findings.summary: Initial reflection failed with a real SQLite initialization error, then a subsequent call succeeded.
evidence: Event 0 is vault_reflect with isError=true: table artifact_fts already exists.
Event 4 repeats the same reflection arguments successfully before drafting/validation; final counts match that successful report.
The final note and handoff accurately disclose the failure and retry.
findings.interpretation: This is an observed, recovered tool failure and a possible initialization-concurrency concern, not a failed reconciliation outcome. Parallel-start timing is consistent with a race but does not prove its cause.
findings.action: Preserve the error in evidence; investigate initialization concurrency separately if relevant. Do not describe this trial as error-free.

grounding_assessment.summary: All Part A rows, gap IDs, status preflight results, missing-edge observations and applied/rolled-back descriptions match actual artifacts and successful tool results. Part B provides three alternatives and conditions for changing the recommendation. Main qualification is T2, plus T1 notification completeness.
grounding_assessment.handoffs: Blocker, rollback, persistent invalid note and host refusal outcomes are accurately described. note-invalid says No commit, push, PR, or merge occurred; actual pre-existing PR #12 remains open and untouched, so this should be read as no PR action rather than nonexistence of a PR.
grounding_assessment.limits: Filesystem reads and diff commands are not logged by the harness; handoff statements about their exit codes cannot all be independently verified. The SQLite error is logged and verified. Small one-paragraph fixtures do not stress context truncation or full-body limits.
